item.title: Was Google’s 100-Year Bond a Sign?
item.description: Alphabet is a fantastic company, and it’s emerging as the leader in AI implementation. But I can’t help but think that years from now, we’re going to look back at the century bond as a high-water mark of tech hubris. Our trading horizon at Money & Markets is significantly shorter than 100 years. I build trading strategies with horizons ranging from a few days to a few years.
